sections.title: Overview
sections.html:
Too many separate tools

Public conversation, offender records, bank statements, seized devices and paperwork each sit in a different system with a different login.

Intelligence stays in silos

What one unit finds about a person is not seen by the station or wing working the same person next door.

Every step must hold up

Evidence, searches and decisions must be recorded properly so they stand in court, in audit and in information-rights requests.

Built on the three Smart Apps platforms

GARUDA is a separate vertical for policing. It draws on all three flagship platforms, and each platform keeps its own page for everything it does outside policing.

Flagship · Access Genie

AI video and operational intelligence

Camera analytics and the operational policing products that run on the Access Genie platform.

 Flagship · Blura SAGA

Social media & web intelligence

Watches public social media, news and websites, and flags threats, unrest, misinformation and citizen grievances early.

 Flagship · EduGenie

Workforce management

A workforce management platform covering ERP, CRM and LMS.
Shared data model

One person. One GARUDA ID.

Each product adds its own piece to the same person's record. An officer who opens a subject sees all of it on one screen, with every item traced back to the product and the source it came from.

Identity & aliasesRisk score Case historyFinancial links Device findingsRegistry status
Safeguards

Fast for the officer. Accountable for the department.

  • Single sign-on; what an officer sees depends on rank, unit and jurisdiction, and access is removed in one click on transfer.
  • Searches, views, downloads, approvals and AI drafts are logged with who, when and why — exportable for vigilance, audit or court.
  • AI suggests, the officer decides. Section suggestions, risk scores, face matches and drafted documents are reviewed before any action.
  • Data stays in the state. Language and AI models run on local servers, so case data is not sent to outside AI services.
  • Phone numbers, account numbers, dates of birth and victim details are masked by default; revealing them needs a reason, and is logged.
  • Evidence is hashed when captured and its chain of custody recorded, with statutory certificates produced for digital records.
